definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.intro: For the purposes of these Terms and Conditions, the following terms have the meanings defined below:

Any individual or legal entity that registers and/or uses our Services, whether as a brand owner, distributor, or consumer.

services.title: Our Services
services.intro: AuthenticGuards provides various authentication and product protection services, including but not limited to:

items.title: Hologram Sticker
items.description: Authentication label with premium hologram technology, unique QR code, and 6-digit scratch PIN.

items.title: Garment Label
items.description: Textile label specifically for the fashion industry with authentication technology integration.

items.title: Brand Protection
items.description: Real-time monitoring system to detect counterfeiting and anomalies.

items.title: Supply Chain Security
items.description: End-to-end tracking from factory to consumer hands.

items.title: API Integration
items.description: RESTful API and GraphQL for integration with clients' existing systems.

items.title: Dashboard Analytics
items.description: Web-based platform for monitoring and verification data analysis.
